scope: Propagated beyond-VRAM case: a plane-wave pulse through a pillar-array lens, a downsampled spectral output plane, an angular-spectrum focal objective and the dense epsilon VJP. Physical-VRAM comparison, timing and memory figures are stated separately; no throughput superiority or converged design is claimed.

memory.scope: RSS and private bytes are this process, sampled every half second; device in use is the whole GPU (every process) from cudaMemGetInfo; disk bytes are psutil machine-wide counters over the phase. None of these are added together.

forward_workspace.transfer_scope: Logical workspace payload bytes, not measured PCIe transactions.
